text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 4) 2020.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 22 Mei 2020 hingga 3 Jun 2020.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Cili merah

2. Sawi hijau

3. Lada benggala hijau

4. Bendi

5. Tomato

6. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

7. Ikan kembung termasuk ikan mabung (anggaran berat antara 7 ekor

hingga 10 ekor sekilogram)

8. Ikan selayang (anggaran berat antara 7 ekor hingga 10 ekor sekilogram)

9. Ikan aya atau tongkol (anggaran berat antara 1 ekor hingga 2 ekor

sekilogram)

10. Ikan demuduk, sagai, cermin atau cupak (anggaran berat antara 3 ekor

hingga 5 ekor sekilogram)

11. Ikan kembung segar beku (anggaran berat antara 8 ekor hingga 10 ekor

sekilogram)

12. Ikan selar segar beku (anggaran berat antara 8 ekor hingga 10 ekor

sekilogram)

13. Ikan selayang bulat segar beku (anggaran berat antara 12 ekor hingga

14 ekor sekilogram)

Dibuat 21 Mei 2020

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/VIII]

 DATUK ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

 Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri

dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 4) ORDER 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the

Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 4) Order 2020.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for

the period from 22 May 2020 to 3 June 2020.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Red chilli

2. Green mustard

3. Green capsicum

4. Lady's finger

5. Tomato

6. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including Beijing

cabbage)

7. Indian mackerel (weight estimation ranges from 7 fishes to 10 fishes

per kilogram)

8. Scad (weight estimation ranges from 7 fishes to 10 fishes per kilogram)

9. Tuna (weight estimation ranges from 1 fish to 2 fishes per kilogram)

10. Malabar trevally (weight estimation ranges from 3 fishes to 5 fishes

per kilogram)

11. Frozen fresh Indian mackerel (weight estimation ranges from 8 fishes

to 10 fishes per kilogram)

12. Frozen fresh yellow scad fish (weight estimation ranges from 8 fishes

to 10 fishes per kilogram)

13. Frozen fresh round scad fish (weight estimation ranges from 12 fishes

to 14 fishes per kilogram)

Made 21 May 2020

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/VIII]

DATUK ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Minister of Domestic Trade

and Consumer Affairs
